title: Add search and empty-state feedback to installed local models
goal: Help users quickly find an imported GGUF model by name when multiple models are installed.
context: The Models screen currently lists every installed model without a filter. A small local search makes model management easier and should not change model loading or selection behavior.
forbidden_changes: Do not change model import, deletion, loading, unloading, or selection semantics.
Do not add network access or persist search terms.
Do not modify provider routing or runtime behavior.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance without testing a real iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: Installed models can be filtered by case-insensitive substring of model name.
A clear-search control appears only when the query is non-empty.
The UI shows filtered count versus total installed model count.
A useful empty state appears when the query matches no installed model.
Existing Use, active-model indicator, context-menu Delete, and Import GGUF remain unchanged.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Verify search, clear, and no-results state on a physical iPhone before claiming device acceptance.
recovery: If the model list layout regresses on smaller screens, remove only the count label or compact the search field; preserve the existing model actions.
